securehtml-desc: Waxay kuu oggolaanaysaa inaad HTML aan xaddidnayn ku darto si la oggolaaday oo ammaan ah
securehtml-hashrequired: Khalad: Hash ayaa loo baahan yahay.
securehtml-inputinstructions: Geli magaca furaha (ikhtiyaari), sirta furaha, iyo HTML-ga ceeriin ee aad rabto. Haddii aan magaca furaha la cayimin, furaha ugu horreeya ee $wgSecureHTMLSecrets ayaa loo qaadan doonaa.
securehtml-outputinstructions:
Koobi garee koodka kore SIDA SAXDA AH oo ku dheji tifaftiraha wiki-ga.
Haddii koodka la soo saaray uusan shaqayn, isku day inaad ka saarto dhammaan kala go'ayaasha khadadka HTML-ga gelinta oo dib u soo saar.
